meta.parties: Wanigasuriya v. Hinduma Co Operative Society Et Al

rules.statement: Section 348 of the Civil Procedure Code does not apply where a liability as surety is incurred before the institution of an action and after the dispute has been referred to arbitration.
rules.supporting_quote: "That section applied only where a liability was incurred as surety for the performance of the decree after the institution of the action and before the entering of the decree."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 348 of the Civil Procedure Code
